# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata_list (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata_list" "example_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata_list" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  import_path = "import_path"
  name = "name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `import_path` (String) Filter by import path (case-sensitive literal substring match)
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `name` (String) Filter by rego metadata name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".

### Read-Only

- `result` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))

<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `data` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `import_path` (String) Unique Rego import path in the form metadata.<segment>, with one alphanumeric or underscore segment. Reference it as data.<import_path>.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account
- `updated_at` (String)
